source_findings.bootstrap_environment: Explicit Gemini provider/model, bound two-sample resource gate and immediate headroom check before SDK import/write; -I -S -B, explicit original source and executable-derived site-packages without .pth execution. Credential value not read by this review.
source_findings.bootstrap_families: Core uses unchanged default create_app(); report and workflow pass exact original objects through unchanged create_app(agent=...). Original model/tool/policy surfaces remain intact; no automatic confirmation.
source_findings.capture_driver: Exclusive allocation and selected frozen-copy test membership; isolated stdlib runpy child, explicit captured src/scripts paths, no site-packages or upstream runtime paths. Machine counts and retained source/driver/member identities are checked.
source_findings.dispatch_order: Readiness connects then guards before HTTP request; each client connection guards before sendall. Rejected ownership does not send health or application request bytes.
source_findings.export_integration_scope: Runner invokes raw/public/binding exporters only after terminal closed-state retention. This review checks integration order and captured auxiliary identities; it does not independently validate every exporter algorithm.
source_findings.owned_lifecycle: Create suspended, retain created handles before later operations, assign before resume. Cleanup uses owned handles, sticky forced flag, independent accounting/PID/signaled-main observations and original non-HTTP stop/lifespan path.
